name: Valletta (Malta)
description: A red field charged at the centre with a gold lion rampant.
history: A banner of the arms of Valletta, 'Gules a lion Or', flown in proportions 3:5. Maltese local councils and their arms were introduced in 1993; no separate adoption date for the flag is recorded.

features.symbolism: the arms of Valletta, 'Gules a lion Or'
